mentions.title: King bearings problem - Moparts Forums
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King bearings boxed and stamped .50 mm that measured .75 mm in thickness, in two separate cases. Mislabelled undersize, not an install error.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: a bearing technician reports King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, slipping into the block and cap groove too easily, with a stated risk of spinning the thrust main. Says they would not use them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports in-spec measurements on replacement thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread telling builders to measure every King bearing before installing. Reports the King factory boxing wrong sizes in standard boxes, including 0.25 bearings mixed into standard sets.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 blocks, with the same fault on a King main set for an S65, and advises others not to use King mains on those engines because such a fundamental error means the bearings cannot be trusted.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint combining a quality-control defect with poor handling of the return. Title itself frames King's response as unprofessional, so it is a service complaint as well as a product one.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Single defect report: one main shell in a King SI set was malformed in production, crushed and twisted, and fitted poorly in the block. One bad shell out of a set.
